rules.crouch_free: Standing to crouch or crouch to stand is a Free Action once per turn.
rules.crouch_half: Additional crouch/stand changes cost a Half Action.
rules.prone_speed: Prone characters move at half their movement speeds.

crouch_prone.citation: “While Crouching… -5 to be hit by Ranged Attacks… While Prone… -10 to be hit…”
